settings.heading: Welcome to the help center
settings.text:
Answers about your order and your corrector, all in one place.
Our support team is here Monday to Friday, 9 am – 5 pm AEST.

settings.title: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Answers to common questions about orders and the corrector.

settings.title: Contact Us
settings.text: How to reach us for help or questions.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships we email you a tracking link. You can also check it any time on our Track Your Order page.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days and usually arrive within 7–15 business days.

settings.question: Can I return it?
settings.answer: Yes. You have 30 days to try it. If it isn't right for you, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll arrange a full refund.

settings.question: I ordered the wrong foot.
settings.answer: No problem. Contact us before it ships and we'll switch it, or after delivery and we'll help you exchange it.

settings.question: How do I cancel my order?
settings.answer: Email us as soon as possible with your order number. If it hasn't shipped yet, we'll cancel it and refund you in full.

settings.question: How do I use and charge it?
settings.answer: Fit the toe loop, wrap the frame over your forefoot and fasten it, then switch on and choose a comfortable level. Charge with the USB-C cable included.

settings.heading: How to [contact] us?
settings.text:
Our team is happy to help. Email us at blomaradmin@gmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as we can, Monday to Friday.

We hope the answers above cover most questions. If you need anything else, please don't hesitate to get in touch.
